title: Free AI document editor: write together, accept each change · {name}
description: Write a document with AI in a real editor: headings, lists, tables, checklists. The AI proposes its changes in place, and you accept or reject each one.
h1: Write your document, and have AI improve it without taking it over.
acts: and have AI improve it without taking it over.
lede: Ask {name} for a plan, a letter or a report, or start from a blank page. The document opens in a real editor beside your request: type in it, and press / for headings, lists, tables and tasks. When you ask for changes, {name} proposes them in place, and you accept or reject each one.
cta: Try it with a sample plan
try.ask: Write a one-page plan for the open day of my pottery studio, Atelier Terre, on 14 June from 2 pm to 6 pm: what it is, a checklist of what we need, and a table of who does what. Inès welcomes visitors, Marc runs the demonstrations.

pane.title: A document written in {name}, live
pane.try: This is a real editor. Type in it, tick a task, or press / on an empty line. The marked passages are changes the AI proposes: accept or reject each one, or all at once.

exact.title: It proposes. You decide.
exact.why: An AI that rewrites your page while you look away is no help. {name}’s changes show in place, marked, each with a few words saying why, and nothing is final until you say so.
exact.cards: Accept or reject, change by change
Each change shows where it happens, with a few words on why. Accept or reject them one at a time, or all at once.
What you didn’t ask to change isn’t touched, and undo works on everything, yours and the AI’s.
Select a passage, then ask: the AI knows which one you mean.
where.title: Where your document goes.
where.why: No {name} server keeps your document in a form it can read. What changes is the AI that answers, and you choose it.
where.cards: Your document is a plain file in your browser, encrypted. Nothing we can read reaches us.
Sent to the AI you chose
Your request and the document go to the AI you picked, and nowhere else. Under every answer, {name} says where it was done.
Others read it or write in it only once you share it. Then each person’s caret shows where they are.
catch.items: {name} is free; the AI behind it may not be. Without a sign-up, only the AI on this computer answers.
It is an editor for text, not for page layout: for a poster or an invitation, ask for a design.
Pictures are yours, pasted in, or made by an AI that draws when you ask for one, never taken from the web.
{name} can be wrong. Read its changes before you accept them.
faq.items: Yes, with no account at {name}. The AI that answers may want one: {free} opens a free one, or use a plan you already pay for, or the AI on this computer, with no account at all.
Is it like a word processor?
Yes, a light one: headings, bold and italics, lists, tasks to tick, tables, columns, callouts and links, with / to add any of them. And an AI beside it.
Can I open it in Word?
Yes. Download it as a Word document or as its Markdown file, copy it, or print it.
Can I paste what another AI wrote?
Yes. Text pasted from a chat becomes real headings, lists and tables in your document.
Can several people write in it?
Yes. Share it to work on it together: each person’s caret shows live.
Does it work in my language?
Yes: you write in yours, right to left too, and the AI answers in it.

end.why: The request opens in {name} and is answered at once, or as soon as you choose an AI. Then write your own.
